# custom-fields fixture

These files are an unchanged copy of KiCad's `qa/data/pcbnew/custom_fields`
project at the `9.0.7` tag:

https://gitlab.com/kicad/code/kicad/-/tree/9.0.7/qa/data/pcbnew

They are maintained by the KiCad project and covered by KiCad's GPL-3.0
license. No expected exports are committed; live-export tests record the
detected `kicad-cli` version and skip when the binary is unavailable.
